summary: Verified backend + frontend behavior for the three benefit types (standard, ssi, pre_1997). Backend correctly implements SSA rules (3rd Wed for birth_day 15, 1st for SSI, 3rd for pre_1997, adjusted backward for weekends/holidays). Frontend correctly HIDES birth-date input for SSI and pre_1997 and shows the corresponding info notes. All 12 pytest cases pass. Concrete-month verification (today = 2026-07-07): STANDARD next = Wed, Jul 15, 2026 (3rd Wednesday of July - correct); SSI next = Fri, Jul 31, 2026 (Aug 1, 2026 is Saturday, shifted to prior Friday - correct); PRE_1997 next = Mon, Aug 03, 2026 (Jul 3 already passed, Aug 3 is Monday - correct). Also observed subsequent SSI Oct 30 (because Nov 1 is Sunday) and Pre-1997 Oct 02 (because Oct 3 is Saturday) - both SSA-adjusted correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: parse_birth_day silently defaults to 15 when input is invalid. For 'standard' benefit with a malformed birth_date, the API returns a valid schedule instead of a 400 - this is a permissive design choice that may mask front-end bugs. Consider returning 400 for invalid birth_date when benefit_type=='standard'.

server.py: countdown 'hours' and 'minutes' derived from delta.seconds; for negative delta the seconds attribute is not meaningful. Safeguard via max(0, ...) prevents negatives but if delta straddles zero the values may be misleading. Acceptable for MVP.
App.js is ~960 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting Calculator, ResultCard, ScheduleTable, and FAQ into separate components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None - each pytest run inserts a small number of calculation logs into MongoDB via the /api/calculate endpoint; no cleanup required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_payment_checker.py and covers: root, stats, all 3 benefit types, invalid benefit, standard 3-wednesday-rule (per-item), SSI 1st-of-month rule (per-item), pre_1997 3rd-of-month rule (per-item), and stats increment. Frontend uses data-testid=calculator-benefit-type-select, calculator-birth-date-input, ssi-info-note, pre-1997-info-note, calculator-submit-button, result-payment-date, result-explanation-text, result-countdown-display. Today in container is 2026-07-07 so upcoming months to look at start with July 2026.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
